title: A query measure defined on one table is used unqualified and can aggregate another table

source.quote: The measure expression can be used with any other expression in the same query.
source.supports: the DAX queries page defines measures on a table of its own and uses them unqualified in SUMMARIZECOLUMNS

derivation: The measure is on Product but counts Sales rows in the filter of each country: US is Ann (rows 1, 2, 7) and Bob (rows 3, 4), 5 rows; JP is Cho (rows 5, 6), 2 rows; FR (Dee) has none, BLANK, and its row is dropped.
